scientific_integrity: The supremum is proved analytically by a binomial representation, stochastic monotonicity, a lazy-random-walk reduction, and an exact central-binomial identity. Finite computations are only reproducibility checks and are not used to establish the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is bivariate and concerns only the EPD Bernstein copula in the published incomplete-beta representation. It does not determine multivariate defects, arbitrary Bernstein-copula approximation rates, or other norms. Bibliographic searches cannot exclude an equivalent older approximation-theory identity under unrelated terminology.
title: Exact uniform comonotonicity defect of the EPD Bernstein copula
